The facts: Lin borrowed money, used his son's house as collateral, then borrowed back the property certificate from Ma, then due to lack of funds, mortgaged the house to a bank and forged a fake property certificate to give back to Ma. So forging a property certificate is forging a state document. The prosecution says it's "伪造国家机关证件罪". However, is that correct? The property certificate is a real estate registration certificate, which is a state-issued document. So forging it is indeed forging a state document. Also there may be fraud (诈骗) for borrowing money under false pretenses? He borrowed from Ma using the house as collateral, then gave a fake certificate. That could be fraud. Also possibly "非法占有" or "诈骗" (fraud). The prosecution only charges forging state document.
